rules.sentence: More than half of all cases of mononeuropathy multiplex can be traced to a systemic vasculitis involving the vasa nervorum.

In Said’s series of 425 cases of vasculitis (2005) affecting the peripheral nerves, 24 percent were associated with polyarteritis nodosa, 23 percent with rheumatoid arthritis, and about 32 percent with other connective tissue diseases; in 21 percent there were no signs of vasculitis beyond the peripheral nerves.
